note: Noble, side view facing right, with a sword at the left. Head is the big dark hair and beard, bottom y~425-430 at the beard; the high blue collar with red lining, gold-frogged coat, belt, the long red cape behind and the coat skirts are torso. Visible limbs are odd: the near arm is the rounded blue sleeve at the middle of the body (shoulder y472, elbow halfway y~568 since nothing marks it, gold cuff down to y~664) ending in a relaxed bare fist y664-726; the far arm on the right is a sleeve with gold cuff (elbow guessed y~562, wrist y~637) ending in a fist y636-706. In addition a third, gripping hand (dark glove with pale fingers, x298-368 y578-672) holds the sword behind the cape at the far left with no visible arm; it is labelled as a second leftHand piece, and the arm is hidden so nothing else. The sword is equipment: the blade from its tip at (168,394) to the gold crossguard at (328-384, 550-602), kept off the hand. Under the long coat the hip is the hem y~806 and covered thighs get no label; the tall boot shafts are lower leg (knee hidden under the hem), ankles at the instep (left y872, right y862).
